# Chip

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasChip> CreateChip( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, const std::string& label, bool closable = false);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasChip> CreateFilterChip( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, const std::string& label, bool selected = false);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasChip(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasChip(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasChip(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | _Click_ |
| `onClose` | `std::function<void()> onClose` | × pressed (owner should remove it) |
| `onSelectedChanged` | `std::function<void(bool)> onSelectedChanged` | _Selected changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
